caption: The drawing depicts a figure wearing a hooded cloak that resembles an animal hide, complete with two rounded shapes at the top suggestive of ears. The cloak is rendered in shades of brown, with subtle highlights of green, yellow, red, and blue throughout, giving it a textured and multi-colored appearance. The face of the figure is visible through an opening in the cloak, showing dark hair, eyebrows, and intense eyes with defined features, shaded mainly in earthy tones with accentuated shadows. The background is plain, and beneath the drawing are handwritten notes in red and purple ink, stating "EASTERN WOODLAND. HALL. CASE — 2. E. 'LIFE SIZE' MALECITE TRIBE — 20” high. (ALGONKIN)," along with the artist's name "Michael Trekur" and the date "October-16-1935."
title: Head Dress
